title: Repair an ImagePullBackOff
prompt:
The Pod of Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-ts-image` is stuck in `ImagePullBackOff` and cannot start.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Investigate why the Pod fails to start and repair Deployment `web`.
2. Ensure Deployment `web` uses the image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-ts-image
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-missing-tag

checks.description: Pod of Deployment `web` is Running and Ready
checks.failure_hint: The image tag cannot be pulled — set the image to nginx:1.27-alpine.
Use kubectl set image deployment/web web=nginx:1.27-alpine -n cka-ts-image.

checks.description: Deployment reports at least 1 available replica
checks.failure_hint: No replica is available while the image cannot be pulled.

commands: kubectl -n cka-ts-image set image deployment/web web=nginx:1.27-alpine

reference_solution:
Set a pullable image tag.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-ts-image set image deployment/web web=nginx:1.27-alpine
```
hints: Describe the failing Pod in `cka-ts-image` (`k -n cka-ts-image describe pod`) and check the Events table.
Compare the configured image reference on container `web` against valid `nginx` tags (`nginx:1.27-alpine`).
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-ts-image set image deployment/web web=nginx:1.27-alpine
